{"version":"v2","title":"VIP-81 VAI Stability Fee","description":"### Summary

The VAI Stablecoin has been unpegged for numerous months, and we are prepared to deliver a solution that will bring VAI back to its $1 peg and keep it near that level going forward.

A bug was found in the stability fee implementation proposed in VIP-80. Executing VIP-80 would have lead to increased interest for those who minted VAI in the past. The team has decided to relaunch the proposal with the corrected version of the code.

### Details
Venus will introduce a stability fee to keep VAI at or near its peg via market dynamics.

An interest rate, initially set at 1%, will be charged for minting VAI. The rate will set by governance going forward. This variable rate will encourage more minting when demand is high and VAI’s price is over $1.00 while discouraging minting when demand is low and VAI’s price is below $1.00.

The stability fee will be adjusted based on a base rate, the price of VAI, and a floating rate. The stability rate is an annual rate divided by the yearly number of blocks on the BNB  Chain, creating a stability rate per block.

A small stability fee for minting and burning VAI discourages users from buying and selling below or above the price of $1.00, reducing price volatility while creating value for Venus Protocol. Stability fee income will be used for handling extreme conditions such as bad debt, risk funds, and outlier events.

Before the VAI Stability Fee, a user's VAI mint limit was based on their total supplied funds without considering the collateral factor of those funds. If a user minted VAI up to the amount of their unused liquidity, they would put their account into immediate liquidation because they would have surpassed the collateral value of their supply. The VAI Stability Fee in Venus V4 allows users to only mint VAI based on their weighted supply rather than their total supply to reduce liquidations.","forDescription":"I agree that Venus Protocol should proceed and introduce VAI Stability Fee","againstDescription":"I disagree and Venus should NOT proceed and introduce VAI Stability Fee","abstainDescription":"I am indifferent to whether Venus Protocol introduces VAI Stability Fee or not"}

metadata.title:
{"version":"v2","title":"VIP-79 Whitelist BNB Chain as sole liquidator of the BNB Exploiter address","description":"**Description**

The Venus Community and it’s delegators are submitting a VIP on behalf of the BNB Chain core team, following their proposal: https://community.venus.io/t/bnb-chain-core-team-as-the-sole-liquidator-of-the-bnb-exploiter-address/3202 

As market is very volatile, there is a potential risk that if liquidated, this large portion of BNB may cause more cascading liquidations effect and unnecessary damage to the market and cause more risks to Venus, Venus users, BNB token and BNB Chain.

The aim of this proposal is to introduce whitelisting capability for performing liquidations, specifically targeting the liquidation of the BNB bridge exploiter’s position on Venus.

BNB Chain core team proposes to be the sole liquidator of this position in order to safely control the outsized volume of BNB to offload.

Once the proposal is accepted, we will work with Binance and other BNB Chain Ecosystem players to take over the position in case it hits the liquidation line, by repaying the debt in a joint effort. The stability and fund coverage of Venus will be put at the high priority.
","forDescription":"I agree that Venus Protocol should proceed with this proposal","againstDescription":"I do not think that Venus Protocol should proceed with this proposal","abstainDescription":" I am indifferent to whether Venus Protocol proceeds or not"}

{"version":"v2","title":"VIP-78 XVS Emissions Reduction","description":"
**Summary**

DeFi lending protocols often use rewards in the form of token emissions to boost supply and borrow APYs, in hopes of attracting new users. Nonetheless, high emissions rates increase the protocol’s token circulating supply, affecting the price negatively, especially in a bear market.

When market conditions are not favorable cutting emissions may have a positive effect on the protocol token price and could also create an opportunity for growth if used as an investment.

Lastly, the previously proposed and ratified prime token program is intended to serve as the strategic solution for boosted supply APY and borrow rate subsidies, ensuring that any valued integrators and protocol participants will continue to reap competitive rates.

**Description**

As approved in the previous Snapshot proposal here: Venus proposal: [Proposal: XVS Emission Reduction (snapshot.org)](https://snapshot.org/#/venus-xvs.eth/proposal/0x096272827dbf9639c1c1082e8979dc8ce478a073f732f662a7d9d666abe0d97d)

**We are proposing the following:**

- Reduce XVS emissions on supply and borrow markets by 50% of their current rate.
- Remove XVS emissions of supply and borrow for SXP.

For the complete details of the proposal, please see link below.

[Proposal: XVS Emission Reduction - Proposals - Venus Community](https://community.venus.io/t/proposal-xvs-emission-reduction/3121)
","forDescription":"I agree that Venus Protocol should proceed and reduce XVS Emissions","againstDescription":"I do not think Venus Protocol should proceed with the XVS Emissions reduction proposal","abstainDescription":"I am indifferent to whether Venus Protocol proceeds to reduce XVS Emissions or not"}

{"version":"v2","title":"VIP-77 Upgrade comptroller and set supply caps","description":"VIP-77 releases the changes implemented in [PR 164](https://github.com/VenusProtocol/venus-protocol/pull/164).

The changes to the Comptroller contract allow for faster and more fine-grained reaction to changing market conditions:

* Supply cap is introduced to prevent market manipulation attacks.
* Risk parameters (collateral factor, supply cap, borrow cap) can now be configured with a risk manager multisig.
* Certain actions can now be paused and unpaused on a per-market basis without a VIP with a pause guardian multisig.

Access control for risk parameters and pausing is now moved to a separate Access Control Manager contract.
Governance owns the access control contract, so the roles can be asigned and unassigned by governance only.

This VIP sets the supply cap for the following markets:

* SXP: 25M SXP
* LTC: 2M LTC
* XRP: 1B XRP
* BCH: 500K BCH
* DOT: 33M DOT
* LINK: 15M LINK
* FIL: 9M FIL
* ADA: 1B ADA
* DOGE: 4B DOGE
* MATIC: 262M MATIC
* CAKE: 7M CAKE
* AAVE: 422K AAVE
* LUNA: 0 LUNA
* UST: 0 UST

The supply cap of 0 means that no further supply is allowed (so nothing changes for LUNA and UST). The supply caps are subject for further adjustment.
","forDescription":"I agree that Venus Protocol should upgrade the Comptroller contract and set the supply caps","againstDescription":"I do not think that Venus Protocol should upgrade the Comptroller contract and set the supply caps","abstainDescription":"I am indifferent to whether Venus Protocol upgrades the Comptroller contract and sets the supply caps"}

{"version":"v2","title":"VIP-72 Gauntlet Market Risk Management","description":"Summary

Following the successful passing of the Snapshot proposal: https://snapshot.org/#/venus-xvs.eth/proposal/0x4e5e9dcae3f7b12d103ebfe8e6d95d8706815dcd97689abd9419893772f7fd4f 

Venus Protocol is now launching a VIP proposal for the community to vote on officially contracting Gauntlet Networks risk management services. 

A proposal for continuous market risk management to optimize yield, capital efficiency, and mitigate depositor losses.

Background

Venus’s previous interest rate model and conversations with the Venus team shows the importance protocol stakeholders put towards understanding and mitigating risk. Over the past few years, Gauntlet has deployed our simulation platform to similar lending protocols and we are happy to state Gauntlet’s work has resulted in strengthening protocol structure and we continue to make parameter recommendations to optimize for capital efficiency as well as reduce insolvency risk.

Preventing insolvency is not the only market risk Venus faces. Deflationary spirals and shocks to market prices can’t simply be prevented without reducing the protocol’s utility. Tail-event scenarios are rarely the result of bad actors taking malicious actions against the protocol. The vast majority of Venus’s participants are honest but what’s good for the lender is not always good for the borrower. Depositors lend, borrowers borrow, and liquidators rebalance. This intersection is where Gauntlet comfortably sits, directing traffic per the stated desires of the community.

Gauntlet will onboard and then continuously rerun our simulations for the Venus Protocol, pushing regular changes to ensure optimal risk parameters. We will also deploy our asset listing framework to ensure new assets being proposed for the Venus Protocol meet the market risk standards that the community has set forth.

Proposal

The initial proposed scope will control for the target metrics Gauntlet aims to improve. Those metrics are:

Value at Risk
Liquidations at Risk
Borrow Usage
Gauntlet will improve the metrics above without increasing the net insolvent value percentage or the slashing run percentage.

Complete details: https://community.venus.io/t/proposal-market-risk-management/2932

Payment Schedule 

Total contract Value: USD $1.6M over a 2 years period to be paid in USDC or DAI as agreed with Gauntlet.

Payments to be issued on a Trimestral basis. 

Trimestral Payment: 200K USDC

Initial Deposit (VIP-72): 160K USDC

Due at launch on 10/15: 40,000 USDC

Due Jan 15th 2023 and following trimester: 200K

Please note that consecutive payments will be issued from Venus Protocol internal Operations and Marketing fund, not from Venus Treasury. 

The Initial deposit will be refunded to the Treasury.  
","forDescription":"Venus should contract Gauntlet Network","againstDescription":"Venus should not contract Gauntlet Network","abstainDescription":"I don't mind if we contract them or not"}

{"version":"v2","title":"VIP-71 AutoFarm Refund and New Collaboration with Venus","description":"This VIP Proposal is followed by the previously held Snapshot vote help on August 18th 2022. [Venus proposal: AutoFarm Refund and New Collaboration with Venus. (snapshot.org)](https://snapshot.org/#/venus-xvs.eth/proposal/0xd4b0244a90aeb8f2024f87bce26b3a2e01657aa85127919737c5cbe4588cdc49)

**Description**

On the 21st of April 2021, there was an incident on the Autofarm platform that resulted in a loss of tokens for users leveraging the Autofarm Venus vaults and created a long lasting issue between the protocols. To come to a conclusion which is beneficial for all affected parties, Autofarm posted [a new proposal](https://community.venus.io/t/autofarm-proposal-v2-collaboration-with-venus/2920) on the Venus Community Forum. After a successful [Snapshot vote](https://snapshot.org/#/venus-xvs.eth/proposal/0xd4b0244a90aeb8f2024f87bce26b3a2e01657aa85127919737c5cbe4588cdc49), the next step is a VIP vote for both Autofarm & Venus communities to vote on.

**Details**

The total number of affected transactions on the Autofarm platform amounts to 10839 transactions (see [here](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1jf7P3tSu4b6M_HoeKTtyNeXs5cl065luhzy9P4LovN4/edit#gid=1168653863)). The funds in question are currently residing in the Venus Treasury and are awaiting a successful resolution through the appropriate governance channels.

In the proposal, Autofarm proposes Venus to return 85% of the affected assets as can be seen in the table in this article [Autofarm Proposal v2: Collaboration with Venus - Proposals - Venus Community](https://community.venus.io/t/autofarm-proposal-v2-collaboration-with-venus/2920)

For technical reasons we couldn't publish the entire proposal here but it is available on Venus Forum: [VIP-71 AutoFarm Refund and New Collaboration with Venus - Protocol Development - Venus Community](https://community.venus.io/t/vip-71-autofarm-refund-and-new-collaboration-with-venus/2976)","forDescription":"I agree Venus should send the specified amounts to Autofarm","againstDescription":"I don't think Venus should agree to this proposal","abstainDescription":"I don't care whether Venus proceeds with this proposal"}

metadata.title: **Venus Ambassador Program: **
metadata.description:
**Venus Ambassador Program: **

Venus Stars, is a program aimed at “Generating adoption of Decentralized Finance, (DeFi) and more specifically in Venus Protocol”. It is based on three main areas, education, information and guidance, and each of them has a general objective from which several activities emerge. 

The intention is that each user who approaches one of our communities is attended to and receives from the hands of their Star leader all the information they need to adopt decentralized finance and the Venus Protocol as the new way of investing, exchanging, earning and diversifying your assets.

For more detailed information:
https://community.venus.io/t/venus-ambassador-program-proposal/2749

metadata.title: # VIP-65 Payment to Hedgey Finance
metadata.description:
# VIP-65 Payment to Hedgey Finance

This proposal sends 9000 BUSD from Venus Treasury to Hedgey Finance wallet. The role of Hedgey Finance will be to advise, provide due diligence, and best practices and expertise as it relates to the various subtasks laid out in this proposal: https://community.venus.io/t/venus-proposal-treasury-tokenomics-advisor-addition/2708

Voting options:
* For – I agree that Venus should make a payment to Hedgey Finance from treasury
* Against – I do not think Venus should pay Hedgey Finance from treasury
* Abstain – I am indifferent to whether Venus will pay Hedgey Finance from treasury

metadata.title: # VIP-64 Enforce new liquidation interface
metadata.description:
# VIP-64 Enforce new liquidation interface

This VIP is being launched to enforce the new liquidation interface. Liquidations will happen via a new Liquidator contract. The old liquidation interface will be disabled.

With this upgrade, 50% of the 10% liquidation fees awarded to liquidators will go to the Venus Treasury as per the Venus Tokenomics.

There are 3 voting options:

* For - I agree that the liquidator contracts should be upgraded
* Against - I do not think that the liquidator contracts should be upgraded
* Abstain - I am indifferent to whether the liquidator contracts should be upgraded

metadata.title: # VIP-62 Set $XVS rewards for UST & LUNA to zero
metadata.description:
# VIP-62 Set $XVS rewards for UST & LUNA to zero

This VIP is to Set $XVS rewards for LUNA and UST to zero. This is a crucial step in deprecating the UST & LUNA markets.

* For - I agree that $XVS rewards for LUNA and UST should be set to zero.

* Against - I do not think that $XVS rewards for LUNA and UST should be set to zero.

* Abstain - I am indifferent to whether $XVS rewards for LUNA and UST should be set to zero.
